Product Design @ Clay

About Alma

Alma is an AI-powered immigration legaltech startup backed by top VCs like Bling Capital, Forerunner, NFX, and NEA. We are on a mission to revolutionize the immigration experience by combining cutting-edge AI with expert legal services.

Why this role matters

As our Product Designer, you will be a key part of the team, responsible for designing intuitive, AI-driven workflows that simplify the complexities of immigration law. Your work will directly shape how individuals and businesses navigate the immigration process, redefining an industry that has remained unchanged for decades.This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoys owning the end-to-end design process, and is excited about building UI/UX for AI-powered experiences.

What You Will Do



- Design AI-driven experiences – Craft seamless UI/UX that helps users interact with Alma’s AI agents and legal workflows effortlessly.

- Detail-oriented & systems thinker – You care about the big picture but also sweat the small details.

- Experience designing for legaltech, fintech, or other regulated industries

- Knowledge of front-end development principles (not required but helpful!)

We recognize that great talent exists everywhere, and our compensation reflects that. We offer a competitive salary, adjusted based on location – e.g., higher pay for folks who can come in-person

title: Product Designer
description:
About Beacon AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Product Designer who wants their work to matter. At Beacon AI, you will shape how pilots interact with AI in the cockpit, designing experiences where clarity, speed, and precision are not just good design principles, they are safety critical. This is a rare opportunity to define a product from the ground up in one of tech's most consequential domains.

Key Responsibilities



- Own the end-to-end product design process for Beacon AI's pilot assistant, from discovery and user research through wireframes, prototypes, and final specs handed off to engineering
- Conduct research and usability testing with pilots and aviation professionals to deeply understand workflows, mental models, and safety critical needs
- Translate complex AI-driven data and alerts into interfaces that are instantly clear and actionable in high-pressure cockpit environments
- Build and maintain a scalable design system that ensures consistency and speed across the product
- Partner closely with engineering and strong product sense to ship polished, well-considered experiences iteratively
- Contribute to brand and visual identity as a secondary responsibility, supporting marketing and web presence as needed

What Will Make You Successful



- You have experience as a sole or founding designer, leading design end to end, moving quickly from concept to execution, and driving products from 0 to 1 without the structure of a large design team
- You have strong product design instincts and can move fluidly from research and strategy to high-fidelity execution
- You are fluent in Figma and comfortable owning a design system end to end
- You ask "why" before you ask "what does it look like" and you push back when a brief is not solving the right problem
- You are energized by complexity and ambiguity, not intimidated by it
- You have a genuine curiosity about aviation, aerospace, or safety critical industries

Bonus Points



- 3+ years of experience in product design, ideally with complex, data-heavy or safety-critical products such as aviation, aerospace, defense, medical devices, or enterprise software
- Proficiency in Figma or similar modern design tools with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work
- Experience designing for AI-powered products and understanding how to make machine-generated insights feel trustworthy and intuitive to end users
- Familiarity with motion design, micro-interactions, or basic HTML and CSS is a plus

title: Product Designer
description:
About Treeswift

In the face of rising threats like severe storms and wildfires, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demands for system expansion, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead.

To accomplish our mission we deploy our sensors into our customers' field operations, typically on backpacks or vehicles. The resulting trove of LiDAR and imagery data is processed through our AI models to deliver actionable analytics through our web platform. To date, our technology has enabled utilities to reduce wildfire, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms.

After starting our work with utilities in June 2024, we are now working with 3 of the 5 largest utilities in the United States and are rapidly expanding across new customers and use cases. To tackle this challenge we are bringing together a team of mission-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker's Inspired Capital.

Treeswift is headquartered in lower Manhattan, and maintains an office in Philadelphia. We also have some customer-facing team members based closer to our customer sites (i.e. Bay Area).

We hope you join us on this journey!

About The Role

You will be Treeswift’s first full-time design hire joining at a pivotal moment: our product is used by some of the largest utilities in the country, and we are scaling from our work with early partners to become the broader platform for modern utility field operations.

This is a rare opportunity to define how design informs our product and organization from the ground up. You will own end-to-end product design across our web platform and hardware physical interfaces, shaping how customers interact with complex geospatial, imagery, and LiDAR data, and establish the design systems and product patterns that allow us to scale across customers, use cases, and teams.

You will be deeply hands-on in the early days, talking to users, mapping workflows, prototyping, designing core product experiences, and partnering closely with product and engineering to ship. You will set the tone for larger design organization: setting the bar for craft, developing repeatable design processes, and influencing the product strategy behind a new category of software and hardware for utilities.

This role is ideal for someone who wants significant ownership, comfortable with high ambiguity, and the chance to build the design function for a mission-driven company from its earliest stages.

What You’ll Do



- Own end-to-end product design. Contribute to design across Treeswift’s core platform, from discovery and workflow mapping through polished designs, prototypes, implementation details, and post-launch iteration.

Exponent Founding Product Designer

Company Description
Exponent is a financial technology platform built for franchise and independent brand operators. We serve a massive, underserved economy — 850,000 doors, a $4 trillion market, billions in annual spend, billions in debt originations, and billions spent every year on accounting services alone. Our platform combines expansion loans, an industry-leading charge card, and an AI-powered bookkeeping product into one integrated financial operating system.
We're an engineering and product-driven team, small and fast-moving, working on hard problems with real economic scale behind them.

Role Description
You'll design across our full platform — loans, cards, and the AI bookkeeper — with the bookkeeper as the center of gravity. This is a system that will sometimes be wrong, and part of the design challenge is building a front end that handles that honestly: surfacing uncertainty, inviting the user to correct us, and getting smarter because they did. You're designing the interaction that makes that correction feel seamless and inevitable, not like extra work.
Beyond the correction loop, you're designing how we communicate value — showing people, clearly and concretely, how much time and effort our product is saving them and their business. And across the platform broadly, you're building a system and point of view for how to take genuinely complex, data-rich information and present it in a way that feels simple and intuitive.
You'll have a lot of agency here and will work closely with engineering and the leadership team — not in a silo, but as a core part of the company’s overall output.

Required Qualifications

- 3–5 years of design experience, including full design ownership of a product launch, start to finish
- Demonstrated ability to translate design decisions into behavioral outcomes — conversion, retention, activation — not just visual polish
- Demonstrated use of AI and modern design tooling in your actual workflow, not just familiarity
- Strong structured thinking and UX flow thinking — you can reason through a system, not just a screen
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with HTML, Tailwind, or CSS, and comfort working with our codebase - either prototyping in code yourself or collaborating fluently with engineers who do
- Experience in fintech, B2B software, or financial technology
- Interest in working with our commercial team and with customers to A/B test and to build tools people genuinely want to use

- Competitive Base + Bonus + Equity
- We have offices in NYC and Boston; and have an in-office culture driving collaboration, innovation, and a strong team dynamic
